Assistant suggested Na Pali Coast Tours, Kauai Sea Rider, Island Adventures Kauai, and Kauai Snorkeling Tours, but the user has not selected or booked an operator (assistant suggested; S1.U6). May also appreciate details about fitness/physical demands, weather and sea conditions, seasonal rough seas, and advance booking, especially in peak season (assistant suggested; S1.U5–U6).
